If you have iOS 14 or higher, there is also a Bible Verse of the Day widget that you can add to your home screen that will update daily.  Countless Bible verses covering a wide variety of topics including Love, Faith, Heaven, Salvation, Devotion, and Life.  We strive to help strengthen your faith and provide a much needed daily devotional.

• Easily share your faith with friends and family
